nodes.label: Scorțișoară
nodes.reason: Accept dominant bark-spice sense. Genitive and qualified ground/stick forms stay within it; boiled-mucenici qualifier avoids asserting the Moldavian bun variant.

nodes.label: Cacao
nodes.reason: Accept dominant edible powder sense. cacaua is dictionary-attested; cacauei is explicitly attested by DMLR and Romanian institutional usage. Powder is not made synonymous with cocoa butter or a prepared hot drink.

nodes.label: Vanilie
nodes.reason: Accept culinary vanilla-pod ingredient, with regular articulated/genitive forms and qualified pod. Actual vanilla appears in the strongest recipe sources; synthetic vanillin is not an alias.

nodes.label: Ciocolată
nodes.reason: Accept common chocolate product; regular plural/genitive plus cooking-chocolate qualified form. The graph does not assert that every chocolate contains cocoa powder; the incoming cocoa edge is limited to homemade variants.

nodes.label: Stafide
nodes.reason: Accept dried grapes, with singular and articulated plural/genitive forms. Fresh Strugure is linked by processing, not treated as the same identity.

nodes.label: Migdale
nodes.reason: Accept edible sweet-almond kernels, regular singular/plural/genitive and explicit sweet-almond form. Culinary tree-nut grouping is not a botanical equivalence; actual almond flakes and ground almonds support the two pastry links.

nodes.label: Alune de pădure
nodes.reason: Accept qualified hazelnut identity. Every alias preserves de pădure, so bare alună and peanut ambiguity stay outside the new exact ownership.

nodes.label: Semințe de floarea-soarelui
nodes.reason: Accept specifically edible sunflower seeds. All three forms preserve the plant qualifier and seed headword; no capture of bare plant name or generic semințe.

limits: These 25 forms are morphology and qualified forms, not 25 synonyms.
Eight new concepts are valid graph inputs, not automatic hidden targets or curated rounds.
Five same-category links use culinary tree-nut vocabulary, not botanical equivalence.
Recipe variants do not establish universality; cocoa powder is not cocoa mass/butter, and white chocolate is not asserted to contain powder.
Audited domain on native metadata is historical coverage provenance, not a native node taxonomy or scoring proxy.
The Condiment type edge is factually correct but may still create indirect ranking noise; final runtime probes must measure it.
Factual source review and exact ownership probes do not replace graph transaction validators, all-game impact tests or Romanian-player review.
source_access_notes: Several recipe pages temporarily returned interstitials; the same primary pages were subsequently verified by indexed text or successful fetch.
Sunflower-bread recipe claim was verified in its author-site indexed result.
The bare cacao page did not expose cacauei; exact DMLR entry and separate Romanian institutional usage provide the checked support.
